subject: cord-scarf plug dancer
pose: 一脚轻抬，线缆绕在胸前
art_direction: 圆润双脚插头穿宽橡胶护套，电线像围巾绕身，青白配荧光黄，动作轻快。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Invent a friendly electrical-plug mascot with a chunky pale-mint rubber body and two rounded insulated foot shapes, not exposed sharp prongs. A short cord loops around the chest like a scarf and ends neatly at the side. The character lifts one foot in a small dance step, wearing a focused little grin. Use a chartreuse face panel, dark blue-gray seams, and soft rubber scuffs. Present it against warm cream in a close three-quarter view. Include no socket, sparks, electricity effects, or technical markings. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
